youtube.title: Why There's a Tiny Table in Your Pizza Box 🍕 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
The small three-legged plastic table in the middle of a delivery pizza is called a pizza saver. A hot pizza fills its box with steam, which softens the cardboard so the lid sags in the middle, and on the way to your door it can sink onto the cheese and pull the toppings off. The little table holds the lid up. It was patented in 1985 by Carmela Vitale, who called it a 'package saver'.
